voice: a bilingual user chatting with their assistant on a messaging app; the assistant keeps short notes
format: chat messages with short timestamps like '3/5 18:42'; some messages entirely in Chinese, some in English, some code-switched mid-sentence; the pending item is the last message
language_mix: mixed Simplified Chinese and English, roughly half and half; VERBATIM strings stay exactly as given in their original language
verbosity: short chat bursts, several messages per topic
notes: Use Chinese for connective text like 记得, 以后, 帮我, 不要; never translate or paraphrase VERBATIM strings. Always write full dates somewhere near dated facts (e.g. 2024-03-05).
